lesson_1: Candidate construction packages report.json status should be set to 'completed' after merge/push, not left as 'candidate_ready_awaiting_manual_review'.
lesson_2: If validate-canonical-repair requires 'completed' status, a minimal evidence status completion candidate must be used to close the gap.
lesson_3: validate-canonical-repair failure (report_status_not_completed) must not be claimed as success or ignored.
lesson_4: R032 acceptance/chain-status update must only proceed after CI green (both validate-round and validate-canonical-repair passing).
lesson_5: PRE_R049 token must never be interpreted as R049 authorization.
lesson_6: RETURN_TO_CHATGPT.txt candidate_commit must be set to the actual commit hash before committing. TBD_AFTER_COMMIT placeholders block manual review and require a no-amend follow-up fix.
lesson_7: When the original commit has TBD_AFTER_COMMIT and cannot be amended, a no-amend follow-up evidence hash fix commit is required. All validators must pass before the follow-up can proceed to manual review.
recommended_process_change: After merge/push of a construction candidate, immediately update report.json status to 'completed' in the same merge commit, or create a follow-up candidate before the CI run completes. Never commit evidence files with TBD_AFTER_COMMIT or placeholder candidate_commit hashes.
